name: PostGrid
description:
This connector provides the full power of the PostGrid platform to Claude:

- Verify postal addresses, appending details such as census info and more
- Design and launch direct mail campaigns including sending letters, postcards, checks, self-mailers, and snap packs
- Send one-off or automated transactional mailings (account statements, insurance claims notices, etc)
- Build targeted mailing lists from demographic and geographic filters to maximize direct mail ROI
- Run analytics and provide insights into your PostGrid mailings, including tracking your mailings at scale

_published_faq.name: How do I add PostGrid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PostGrid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.postgrid.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PostGrid MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PostGrid provides these MCP tools: describe_endpoint, generate_upload_link, make_read_api_call, make_write_api_call, search_api_spec, and wait_for_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PostGrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PostGrid in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
PostGrid requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PostGrid is developed by PostGrid. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
